mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, account_status, record_status, login_ip, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, account_status, record_status, login_ip, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, account_status, record_status, login_ip, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password, email, phone, account_status, record_status, login_ip, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{account_status}, #{record_status}, #{login_ip}, NOW(), NOW() )
